node.statement: Write e=epsilon_r, u=u_delta(X), h=h_delta(X), and a=h-J. By lem-stage1-polar-retraction, u is in calU, h is Hermitian, ||a||<delta<=1/64, and X=u bold-dot h. The involution and two associator estimates give ||X^dagger bold-dot X-h bold-dot h||<40*e: compare (h bold-dot u^dagger) bold-dot(u bold-dot h) with h bold-dot(u^dagger bold-dot(u bold-dot h)), then use u^dagger bold-dot u=J.
